🇮🇪 PhD in ML & Stats

Deadline: 2026-08-31
Location: Ireland
Hiring Organization: University of Limerick

The University of Limerick is offering a fully funded PhD position in Statistics, Causal Inference, and Machine Learning, focusing on developing novel methods for estimating causal treatment effects from electronic health records and observational healthcare data.
Base Salary: €25,000 annual tax-free stipend

The University of Limerick is offering a fully funded 4-year structured PhD position in Statistics, Causal Inference, and Machine Learning. The successful candidate will develop novel statistical and machine learning methods for estimating causal treatment effects from longitudinal electronic health records and observational healthcare data.

Research themes include
• causal inference
• target trial emulation
• dynamic treatment regimes
• doubly robust/debiased machine learning
• heterogeneous treatment effect estimation

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. The position is supervised by Dr. Maurice O'Connell, Associate Professor in Medical Biostatistics. For more information and to apply, visit https://t.co/RidU4sw8qr.

#MachineLearning #Statistics #CausalInference

🇨🇦 PhD in AI Safety

Location: Canada
Hiring Organization: Concordia University

Concordia University is offering a fully funded PhD position in AI Safety, Software Engineering, and Generative AI, supervised by Prof. Shin Hwei Tan.

Concordia University is offering a fully funded PhD position in AI Safety, Software Engineering, and Generative AI. The project aims to develop novel software engineering techniques to identify, evaluate, and mitigate potential harms in generative AI systems.

The successful candidate will work under the supervision of Prof. Shin Hwei Tan, Associate Professor and Gina Cody Research Chair, whose research areas include automated program repair, LLM-based program repair, and software testing.

Key aspects of the project include:

• Developing systematic approaches to identify and evaluate potential harms in generative AI systems
• Designing and implementing software engineering techniques to mitigate these harms
• Investigating the application of LLMs in software testing and repair
Interested candidates should contact Prof. Shin Hwei Tan at shinhwei.tan@concordia.ca to apply.

Full opportunity details: https://t.co/cUItL9QxKZ

#AISafety #GenerativeAI #SoftwareEngineering

research_focus: AI Safety; Software Engineering; Generative AI; LLM Testing/Repair
